title: xv-craft
description: A Vanilla+ Fabric modpack with some backports for an enhanced minecraft playthrough.
body:
A Vanilla+ adventure and exploration modpack built around discovering new structures, progressing through challenging dimensions, and expanding the Minecraft world without straying too far from the core game.

The pack features extensive world generation improvements, overhauled structures, enhanced villages, new creatures, improved farming and cooking, immersive transportation, and a large collection of quality-of-life enhancements. Players can explore the Aether, collect the Eyes required by End Remastered, uncover upgraded dungeons and landmarks, and build thriving settlements in a more dynamic world.

Key Features

The Aether dimension and related content
End Remastered progression system
Dungeons & Taverns structure overhauls
YUNG's world generation improvements
Enhanced villages and exploration
Farmer's Delight and Chef's Delight
Immersive Aircraft
Additional furniture and decoration options
Improved mob and biome variety
Vanilla-friendly quality-of-life improvements
Performance optimizations for both singleplayer and multiplayer

xv-Craft is designed for players who enjoy exploration, progression, adventure, and world-building while maintaining the familiar feel of Minecraft. Whether playing solo or with friends, the pack provides a larger, more rewarding world to discover without overwhelming players with unnecessary complexity.
